relationship_to_frozen_prediction: the prediction threshold and success criteria were frozen 2026-08-11 before this dataset was selected/opened for ORI-C replication
X: median log2 MIC at day 3 for the antibiotic under selection
R_future: median log2 MIC at day 12 for the same antibiotic
technical_replicates: median of three MIC readings before log2 transform
folds: hold out population-replicate index 1, 2, or 3 across all histories and both drugs
bootstrap: 5000 resamples of independent evolved populations stratified by drug
permutation: 5000 permutations of H within drug × replicate-index strata
